resolved_old_gaps.old_gap: Dossier missing list affirmatively flags target provision not located: EO:13349. No EO:13349 text/context is held in this dossier, so its possible alteration of reporting or termination terms cannot be resolved.
resolved_old_gaps.resolution: Full frozen actor context resolves the absent-provision lead as a target-number mismatch: EO 13349 amends EO 13226 (PCAST), not EO 13326 (Space Exploration Commission). It neither extends this Commission nor changes its report/termination clauses.
resolved_old_gaps.exact_quote:
Executive Order 13226 of September 30, 2001, as amended, is further amend-
ed by adding a new section 2(c), to read as follows: 
‘‘(c) PCAST shall serve as the National Nanotechnology Advisory Panel 
under section 4 of the 21st Century Nanotechnology Research and Develop-
ment Act (Public Law 108–153) (Act). Nothing in this Order shall be con-
strued to require the National Nanotechnology Advisory Panel to comply 
with any requirement from which it is exempted by section 4(f) of the 
Act.’’

proofs.proposition: Section 5 sets a report deadline measured from the first meeting, without proving first meeting or report submission.
Section 6(b) terminates the Commission within 60 days after submitting its final report; actual trigger and exact cessation are not supplied.
Affirmative omitted-context lead resolved: only EO 13226 is amended.

results.legal_result: Formal whole revocation confirmed effective 2005-09-30; earliest clause ends remain unproved, so no approval.
